basis.paper: Adolphe2022 DOI10.3389/fpsyg.2022.880375 §2.4.2; nominal50ms, not a published project tolerance

proposedRoute.cadenceSource: observed requestAnimationFrame callback cadence during explicit preflight; not inferred native panel refresh rate
proposedRoute.unsupportedFamiliesProposal: Block before stimulus. No silent floor/ceil, alternating counts, automatic slower protocol or per-device duration correction.

preflight.status: numeric acceptance and review owner/evidence pending; null never means pass

proposedRoute.measuredCadenceChangeDuringAttempt: Proposal: end attempt, retain raw for read-only/original save retry; do not switch frame count or restart exposure. Exact numerical detection rule pending.

proposedClockContract.origin: Keep one actual performance.timeOrigin/pageInstance artifact; new realm ends the attempt. No cross-refresh performance concatenation.
proposedClockContract.rafCallbackTimestampMs: Record exact argument supplied to the callback. It is not a physical pixel timestamp.
proposedClockContract.callbackEnteredPerfMs: Record performance.now at callback entry separately.
proposedClockContract.drawCommandStartedPerfMs: Record performance.now just before actual canvas commands.
proposedClockContract.drawCommandReturnedPerfMs: Record performance.now just after canvas commands return, with exception/context availability facts.
proposedClockContract.firstStimulusDrawMeaning: First stimulus draw-command group actually issued and returned without exception; commit its draw counter only after that result. This does not prove display scanout.
proposedClockContract.firstMaskDrawMeaning: First mask draw-command group issued/returned; record both callback and command on/off identities separately.
proposedClockContract.countMeaning: N stimulus draw groups at distinct increasing rAF callbacks; mask group on following selected callback. No claim that each group was physically displayed.
notAllowed: counting an intended but failed draw as a completed stimulus draw
reusing response/timeout clock as stimulus onset
changing old core onset semantics under same frozen version

futureSidecarShapeProposal.schemaVersion: TBD after platform/content review; no invented production field is being registered
futureSidecarShapeProposal.storage: Trial memory bounded, one boundary write. Full draw events in research archive; core only frozen summaries/references after real schema review.

boundaryExamples.quality: Not granted by this example; real preflight/timing/device rules missing
49.9 is not literal50.0; no epsilon/tolerance is approved. This is a substantive presentation-policy change, not a bug-fix permission.

boundaryExamples.proposedConsequence: BLOCK_INITIAL_ALLOWLIST; mathematical integer alone is not platform approval

boundaryExamples.risk: Blindly counting three callbacks could extend exposure despite a missing/delayed opportunity. Slot count alone is insufficient.
boundaryExamples.proposedConsequence: Before issuing another stimulus group, follow approved interruption/neutralization contract and end attempt; record raw, no individual interpretation. Detection numbers and exact visual neutralization require review/approval.
No fabricated successful onset/counter; retain attempted event/error, end attempt
Do not advance slot counter from invalid callback identity; end attempt under approved technical rule
END_SAME_ATTEMPT; no new exposure, original records remain read-only/retryable

versionImpact.measurementLayer: Frame policy and onset/draw semantics change measurement meaning. Review engine/protocol/stimulus recipe/raw contract identities before implementation; exact next versions follow repository rules, not assigned here.
versionImpact.configAndReferenceLayer: Freeze cadence selection and approved numerical rules with actual config/hash and applicability. Do not pool profiles/devices or reuse norms by default.
versionImpact.reportLayer: Maintain invalid gate until approved evidence; no new interpretability from slot math.
